name: local
description: Local marketplace for alex's Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: refine-prose
plugins.description: Keeps AI output to common spoken English plus real technical terms. Three hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop) enforce an NGSL+NAWL allowlist with a blocklist override and a stem-aware fallback.

plugins.name: ai-marks
plugins.description: Strips AI-trace characters from files and replies. A PostToolUse hook silently rewrites em dashes, smart quotes, ellipsis, and odd spaces to plain keyboard characters. A Stop hook flags the same marks in chat replies.
